flavorText.ruby: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.
flavorText.sapphire: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.
flavorText.emerald: This POKéMON is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various UNOWN.
flavorText.firered: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.
flavorText.leafgreen: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.
